findings.title: Invalid amount input crashes instead of producing an error
findings.explanation: Double(text) returns nil for invalid input such as "abc" or an empty string. Force-unwrapping it traps, terminating the process instead of reporting the required validation error.
findings.recommendation: Return a throwing result or Result type and handle failed conversion explicitly instead of force-unwrapping.
findings.suggested_test: Pass "abc" and an empty string; assert each produces a validation error without crashing. Pass "12.50" and assert successful conversion to 12.5.
